description: Constructed scenes of axis-aligned boxes in view space (x right, y up, z towards the viewer; boxes are [centre x, y, z, width, height, depth]) with hand-computed visible areas of the front face (z = max) of the box named 'back' as seen from +z. area(face) = width * height; 'hidden' is the overlap with the front box's face where the front box is nearer. Interpenetrating and coplanar cases have no hand area: their verdict is the per-point nearest hit of an independent ray caster (three Raycaster).

cyclic.name: three bars lying over one another
